curator_notes: 3-AP radiosensitization verified in CaSki (HPV16 E6/E7 virally silenced p53): enhanced radiation-related cytotoxicity (Kunos et al. 2009). Per-line effect sizes pending curation from source figures.

protocol_parameters.dose_and_fractionation: single-dose study design; exact Gy per gamma/cell-cycle figure tables pending curation (Kunos et al. 2009)
protocol_parameters.sequencing: 3-AP treatment (RNR inhibition) combined with ionizing radiation; effects read as radiation cytotoxicity, RNR activity, persistence of DNA damage, cell-cycle arrest
protocol_parameters.readout: radiation-related cytotoxicity rescue-block readout; radiation-induced DNA damage duration; G1/S arrest

modifier.estimated_relative_cost_note: Requires radiotherapy delivery equipment and a trained clinical team -- dedicated clinical infrastructure, comparable in tier to TTFields/HBOT, not a bedside or outpatient device.

key_mutations.variant: E6/E7 oncoprotein expression; TP53/RB1 pathway silenced (virally silenced p53 per Kunos et al. 2009)

drug.name: Triapine (3-AP)
drug.target: Ribonucleotide reductase M2 subunit (iron chelation of the tyrosyl radical site)
drug.mechanism_of_action: Iron chelation inactivates the RNR tyrosyl radical, depleting dNTP pools and impairing DNA-damage repair

evidence_tier_definition.label: Tier 1 — Direct
evidence_tier_definition.definition: The combination was tested empirically in the same study: drug and modifier were applied together and death/viability was measured.
